sentences.text:
Dr. Justice B.R. Sarangi
 Mr. Justice M.S.Sahoo
 Order
21.02.2023 Order No.
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
Claiming for higher compensation, the petitioners has filed this writ petition.

3. Mr. P.R. Barik, learned counsel for the petitioners contended that claiming for higher compensation, remedy is available under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, but since the competent authority has not been appointed, the petitioners have approached this Court by filing this writ petition.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Now, the competent authority has been appointed.
Therefore, it is open for the petitioners to pursue their remedy before the appropriate forum.
5. With the aforesaid observation the writ petition is disposed of.
6. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
